limitations: Manual source review of twenty named command handlers, not all application writers
Retains original proposed classification, not operator acceptance
DI/controller source is not runtime reachability or complete dispatch proof
Multi-save generated IDs, audit split, shared actors, tombstones and cross-store membership lookup require native binding
Current long ID routes/DTOs remain B4 parser/compatibility work; no new ID syntax adopted
